title: Marco Rubio's SSCI staff seek whistleblowers

tellings.quote: Marco Rubio who you know UFO heads who are deep in the subject have known he's had an interest in the subject since 2017 and has employed his staff at the SSCI and others to go uh find more about whistleblowers for him.

plain: Marco Rubio has been interested in UFOs since 2017, the story goes, and has sent his staff on the SSCI, the Senate's intelligence committee, and others to find out more about whistleblowers for him. The teller is a researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb, after UAP, the official term for UFOs. He tells Michels it is something people deep in the subject have long known, without naming a source. If true, it would mean a senior senator has been quietly gathering insiders willing to talk about secret UFO work.
